answer: You have a real option: take out a loan to buy a place in a nicer part of town, move out immediately during the short closing period (which is required for residential property), and keep your own bank account for all funds. After one month you are considered an ex, so neither spouse can demand anything from the other including secrets or future support, and your own money is untouched. There is little point in filing for legal proceedings afterward because most courts will say relationships are to be worked out privately and rarely order child custody or alimony once a home sale happens.
